heading.title: Chief Commissioner and State Commissioner for Persons with Disabilities

article.title: Action of appropriate authorities on recommendation of Chief Commissioner.
article.content:
76Action of appropriate authorities on recommendation of Chief Commissioner.

Section 76  ·  Chapter XII  ·  page 27 of the Act
Whenever the Chief Commissioner makes a recommendation to an authority in pursuance of clause (b) 1[of sub-section (1)] of section 75, that authority shall take necessary action on it, and inform the Chief Commissioner of the action taken within three months from the date of receipt of the recommendation:
Provided that where an authority does not accept a recommendation, it shall convey reasons for non-acceptance to the Chief Commissioner within a period of three months, and shall also inform the aggrieved person.
1 Ins. by Act 4 of 2018, s. 3 and the second Schedule (w.e.f. 5-1-2018).
